text: Program Description Immunology is a biomedical science that studies the immune response of organisms to antigens and its methods. Immune response is the body's response to antigen stimulation, and it is also a biological process to identify and eliminate antigens.Future Career Students can work to aquatic product department commonly, also can undertake scientific research work to the department such as ocean, shipping, light industry, foreign trade, environmental protection, also can choose this respect project to undertake operation.Duration 3 years
